name: Park Rangers Capital
identity_check: Confirmed as parkrangerscap.com, Erica Wenger's pre-seed and seed fund for community- and distribution-led founders ('elephant founders'); Fortune (2025-11-14) names her and a $4.3M first fund. Portfolio page lists Beehiiv, Clay, Superpower, Ridley, Castle, Soxton. Not Park Capital, Park Partners or Park Rangers in the public-lands sense; parkrangers.vc does not resolve.
